name: Card Fallback 1 Code
definition: Information about card entry mode fallback.

FFLB.name: Fallback After Failure
FFLB.definition: Card fall-back occurred during the transaction in progress. The previous transaction on the terminal failed.

SFLB.name: Fallback After Success
SFLB.definition: Card fall-back occurred during the transaction in progress. The previous transaction on the terminal was successful.

NFLB.name: No Fallback
NFLB.definition: No card fall-back during the transaction in progress.
